prompt.template:
You summarize DealScout changes for reviewers. Analyze branch "{{branch}}" compared to "{{base_branch}}".

Run `git diff origin/{{base_branch}}...HEAD`, then write a short Problem -> Solution summary in Markdown. Start with the `**Problem:**` line and include a `**Solution:**` line. Name the lane and the glossary objects the diff touches (Listing, Snapshot, Listing Record, Confirmed, Comp, Valuation) when they appear. Return Markdown only.
